xmldoc.short_description: Copy graphics objects and their children.

param_input_item.param_description: a graphics object or an array of graphics objects to copy.
a scalar graphics object: the parent of the copies.

param_output_item.param_description: an array of graphics objects with the same size as h: the new objects.

description.p: c = copyobj(h, parent) creates a new graphics object for each element of h, gives it the property values of the original and attaches it to parent. Children are copied too, so copying an axes also copies its lines, surfaces, texts and so on.
c = copyobj(h) attaches each copy to the parent of its original.
The copies are independent: changing a property of a copy does not change the original.
Mode properties such as XLimMode or XTickMode keep their 'auto' or 'manual' value on the copy, so an axes copied with automatic limits still adjusts them to the data it receives later.
Copying a figure always creates a new top-level figure, whatever parent is; the new figure becomes the current figure.
When several objects are copied into a parent that stacks its children (such as an axes), the copies are listed in c in the same order as in h.
The root object cannot be copied (error Nelson:copyobj:cannotCopyRoot). An input that is not a graphics object raises an error.

example_item.example_item_description: Copy a line into the axes of another figure.
